notes.title: V1.1.2 Release
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed issue where changing combo boxes sometimes wouldn't update the render
[*] made changes that will hopefully make rendering crashes not leave orphaned processes
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]added a new node (folder source) to allow users to select a folder, and quickly switch between all ies files in that folder
[*]added some more mix options to the mix node
[/list]

notes.title: CNDL v1.1.1 Release
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your feedback, it is very valuable to our continued development of CNDL. In v1.1.1 we have fixed a few bugs that have been brought up by users, and improved the render pipeline.

[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Issue where installing CNDL on some non C: drives would cause render to not show
[*] Improved render speed significantly
[/list]
